title: Report an issue
changes: A reviewer can now point at any part of the page and say what is wrong with it. Press Report an issue, bottom left; the page outlines whatever is under the cursor; click it and describe the problem.

Reports collect into a list with a counter beside the button. The list exports as a readable Markdown summary grouped by page, or as a JSON file carrying the selector, the text on screen, the page, the language and the build each report was made against.

Reports describe and never change. The sibling tool this is modelled on could also stage edits to the page itself; that is deliberately left out here, because what is on screen is somebody's family testimony and a reviewer's note must never be mistaken for the record.
Nothing is uploaded. Reports stay in the reviewer's browser until they export them.
